findings.message: Bare CTID where an IRI belongs: right identifier kind, wrong form. Registry references use the CTID-based URI https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/<CTID>.

rule.citation: About the CTID, section "CTID-Based URI Structure": Registry URIs are constructed from https://credentialengineregistry.org plus /resources/ or /graph/ plus the CTID itself, and "the value of a resource's CTID property will exactly match the CTID portion of that resource's URI".

findings.message: Bare UUID where an entity identifier belongs. This property takes an IRI; for Registry resources that is https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/<CTID>.

rule.citation: The CTDL JSON-LD context declares ceterms:ownedBy with {"@type": "@id"}: its values are IRIs that identify entities, not literals. For Registry resources the IRI form is the CTID-based URI (see About the CTID).

findings.message: Value of an identifier-valued property is neither an IRI nor a blank node identifier.

rule.citation: The CTDL JSON-LD context declares ceterms:ownedBy with {"@type": "@id"}: its values are IRIs that identify entities, not literals. For Registry resources the IRI form is the CTID-based URI (see About the CTID).

findings.message: Blank node reference is not defined anywhere in this payload. A blank node identifier only has meaning inside the graph that declares it, so this reference cannot identify anything.

rule.citation: CTDL All Schemas Handbook, "Blank Node Identifier": a blank node "is only identified, referenced, or retrievable in the context of the graph in which it is found". A blank node identifier that its own payload does not define identifies nothing.
